title: A Mighty Fortress is Our God
lyrics_original: A mighty fortress is our God
A bulwark never failing;
Our helper He, amid the flood
Of mortal ills prevailing:
For still our ancient foe
Doth seek to work us woe;
His craft and power are great,
And, armed with cruel hate,
On earth is not his equal.
Did we in our own strength confide,
Our striving would be losing;
Were not the right Man on our side,
The Man of God's own choosing:
Dost ask who that may be?
Christ Jesus, it is He;
Lord Sabaoth, His Name,
From age to age the same,
And He must win the battle.
And though this world, with devils filled,
Should threaten to undo us,
We will not fear, for God hath willed
His truth to triumph through us:
The prince of darkness grim,
We tremble not for him;
His rage we can endure,
For lo, his doom is sure,
One little word shall fell him.
That word above all earthly powers,
No thanks to them, abideth;
The Spirit and the gifts are ours
Through Him who with us sideth:
Let goods and kindred go,
This mortal life also;
The body they may kill:
God's truth abideth still,
His kingdom is forever.

bible_verses.english: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
My God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge; my savior, you save me from violence.

Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil. For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual hosts of wickedness in the heavenly places.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for being my safe refuge and ever-present help in times of trouble. Forgive me for those moments when I rely on my own weak strength instead of trusting in Your mighty power. Shield my heart against the enemy’s schemes and anchor my soul in Your unwavering love. Lord Jesus, I rest in Your victory today, confident that nothing in this world can tear me from Your hands. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When the storms of life swell around us, Martin Luther's timeless words remind us where our true protection lies. In our own strength, we inevitably stumble under the weight of spiritual battles and earthly trials. But Jesus stands as our unshakeable stronghold, a bulwark that will never fail. Today, let go of the burden of self-reliance and rest securely in the enduring power of our Savior, who has already won the ultimate victory for us.
